prompts.name: 01-carte-compacte
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity radically minimal mobile web screenshot for Coliclic, French parcel transport marketplace outgoing booking requests page. White canvas, navy text, cyan accents, small orange/navy Coliclic wordmark. Flat mobile screen, no device frame or perspective. Aspect ratio 430:700. Minimal small app header with wordmark, hamburger and AT avatar. Under it title "Mes envois" 24px and small cyan text link "Trouver un voyageur" 14px, NOT a filled button.
Only ONE compact request card in the upper portion of screen, approximately 180 CSS pixels tall, 390px wide, thin pale border, 12px corner radius, NO shadow. It has exactly FOUR rows:
1. "Poisson · 3 kg" on left in 14px, small green "Acceptée" pill at right and overflow dots.
2. "Nantes → Abidjan" in 20px bold navy.
3. "France → Côte d’Ivoire" and "18 oct. 2026" in small secondary gray typography 12px.
4. Plain text "Voir les détails" with chevron at left and small 44px high navy "Message" button at right.
Omit email, reference, all icon tiles, all subcards, extra dividers and the cancel button: details or overflow would reveal them. Do not print explanations in image. The card MUST occupy less than one third of total screen height, use realistic restrained typography, DO NOT inflate content to fill screen. The remaining page below is calm blank off white space. Modern sophisticated functional UI, crisp high resolution. No illustrations, mock data, footer, marketing slogans or watermarks.

prompts.name: 02-liste-epuree
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high fidelity mobile web UX concept for Coliclic /sent-bookings, French interface.
Input image: reference image only, for existing brand and booking information. Create a NEW redesigned interface, not a reproduction.
Create ONE polished portrait mobile screenshot, front facing flat UI, about 430x860 CSS pixel proportions. No device hardware, perspective, decorative background, photography, 3D or presentation captions. Fill image with the app screen.
Identity: wordmark "Coliclic" with Coli orange and clic deep navy, small navy avatar "AT", simple hamburger. White/off-white, navy text, restrained cyan primary actions and green textual status. Clean readable sans serif. Realistic mobile typography, generous but efficient space; 44px minimum touch targets. Minimal borders and no nested card containers.
Exact main content: "Mes envois", "Trouver un voyageur", "Poisson", "Acceptée", "Nantes", "France", "Abidjan", "Côte d’Ivoire", "3 kg", "18 oct. 2026 · 09:47", "TRK-05-15", "tuoadama17@gmail.com", "Message", "Voir les détails".
Prioritize route and status; weight, parcel name second; reference, date and recipient lower priority, can be placed inside a visible expanded detail section or hidden behind a clearly labelled details control. Never invent payment, arrival, delivery or tracking progress: accepted request does not mean parcel in transit. Message opens conversation with traveler; recipient email is parcel recipient and must not be labelled traveler. Cancel must be accessible via an overflow menu or discreet "Annuler la demande" action, not a large red primary button. Page is outgoing requests, not live parcel tracking. No truncation of city names. No fake charts or maps. No watermark.
Layout direction 2: BORDERLESS EDITORIAL LIST. Flat pure white page, small header, large title "Mes envois" and text link "Trouver un voyageur". One outgoing request shown as a borderless structured row section separated only by hairline horizontal rules. Small "Acceptée" green status above large stacked city names "Nantes →" and "Abidjan", countries secondary. Under route, line "Poisson · 3 kg", then muted exact date and reference. Bottom a simple outlined Message button and text details link, overflow dots upper right for cancel. No enclosing card, no colored tiles, no illustration, bold typographic hierarchy. Fit content cleanly into approx 430x680 portrait with sensible space.
